description:
AcuityMD, Inc seeks Data Engineer in Boston, MA

Job Duties: Communicate business concepts, technical requirements, recommendations, and code clearly and concisely. Build data transformation and pipelines in any capacity. Explore, transform, and analyze data in any type of relational database. Model new data and improve existing data products with quantitative rigor that solves customer problems and ensures correctness and interpretability. Transform and integrate raw data from multiple sources into usable, documented, and high-quality data and intelligence products by applying data modeling and statistical techniques. Work directly with product managers and cross functional stakeholders to design solutions, validation frameworks, and statistical benchmarks. Full-time telecommuting permitted from anywhere within the U.S. Required travel to company's headquarters, in Boston, Massachusetts, on a quarterly basis.

Minimum Requirements: Master’s degree, or foreign equivalent, in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field plus 1 year of experience in the job offered or a related occupation. Employer will accept a Bachelor’s degree, or foreign equivalent, in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field plus 2 years of progressively responsible experience in the job offered or a related occupation.

Special Skill Requirements: 

(1)Data modeling and ingestion: Experience transforming raw data files into well-structured, documented, and modeled data assets within a database or warehouse, including designing schemas and applying sensible models so the resulting tables are reliable and reusable (1 year)

(2)Experience writing analytic SQL across multiple dialects (e.g., PostgreSQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, Spark SQL) with fluency in window functions, CTEs, and complex joins and aggregations (1 year)

(3)Applied machine learning: Experience applying foundational ML algorithms (e.g., random forest classifiers, logistic regression) to derive insights, including selecting an appropriate algorithm, evaluating performance, and interpreting and explaining model outputs in clear, non-black-box terms (1 year)

(4)Time-series forecasting: Experience forecasting from time-series data using Python libraries such as Prophet (or comparable tools like statsmodels), accounting for trend and seasonality and validating forecast accuracy against held-out data (1 year)

(5)Computational performance at scale: Work familiarity with large datasets (hundreds of gigabytes up to terabyte scale) and an understanding of how to optimize SQL for performance at that size, including exposure to techniques like partitioning, indexing, and reading query plans to keep queries fast and cost-aware (1 year)

(6)Visualization and communication: Experience using data visualization tools such as Tableau or Hex to communicate non-obvious query plans in a fast and cost-aware manner (1 year)

(7)Directing agentic development: Working familiarity with directing autonomous agentic development systems (e.g. Claude Code) to build tools (1 year)

(8)Data quality, testing, and validation: Experience profiling data and building automated checks to catch quality issues (nulls, duplicates, schema drift, out-of-range values) before they reach downstream consumers (1 year)

(9)Healthcare data domain awareness: Exposure to common healthcare data standards and structures (e.g., FHIR, HL7, OMOP, claims/HER data) and experience handling requirements that come with them, including de-identification and working with PHI responsibly under HIPAA (1 year).EOE, including disability/vets.

Salary: $112,861-$159,000.00 per annum. 40 hours per week; M-F, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship. To apply, please send your resume specifying Req.# L25-173152 by email to job.applications@acuitymd.com .

 #BI-DNI
